## Distributed Traces: IRC Fiber Engine

**[Open Explore → Tempo](/grafana/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%22traces%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22Tempo%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22ircfiber-engine%5C%22%7D%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D%7D&orgId=1)** with this TraceQL query pre-loaded:

```
{.service.name = "ircfiber-engine"}
```

Click a trace in the results to open its waterfall. From any span, use **Traces to logs** to pivot to the matching Loki log line(s).
